# The gap for one's own act

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-gap-for-ones-own-act` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](the-gap-for-ones-own-act.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Where the rest follows a law of exchange reading through coupling, an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike, with and without it, by every selection through any member of the closure; with both acts laws nothing is supplied.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. An act's difference stays beyond a formation's coupling closure when each member of the acting part within the closure, coupled alike up to a step, exchanges alike in the two flows with every condition a member of the closure couples into; an act differing only on conditions no member couples into is the plain case. (`Becoming.Flow.ActsAlikeWithin`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsAlikeOnCoupled`, `Becoming.Flow.ActsAlikeOnCoupled.within`)
2. Where the rest follows one law of exchange reading through coupling in two balanced flows with the same formations present, starting alike, and the act differs only beyond the closure, every selection through the coupling of any member of the closure, the actor among them, selects the two flows alike at every step; so a consequence of the act is a selection through no member at any step. The rest's response is derived from the law, not supplied. (`Becoming.Flow.act_unselected`, `Becoming.Flow.act_unselected_of_coupled`, `Becoming.Flow.consequence_unselected`)
3. With both acts laws of what has stood, the first reading through its members' coupling and the two agreeing on every condition coupled into the closure drawn through the two courses, the courses the law generates with each act, where feasible, are selected alike through every member of the closure: neither the second flow, nor the response, nor the levels are supplied. (`Becoming.ExchangeLaw.withAct_take_of_part`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.withAct_give_of_part`, `Becoming.act_courses_unselected`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- That the rest follows a law of exchange reading through coupling (ExchangeLaw.Through) is a supplied condition written into each theorem; balance (or feasibility), the same formations present and the same start are written in too. No axiom.
- That a selection goes through a formation's coupling (Web.SelectsThrough) is a condition, as in selection-through-registration.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which law the rest follows, or that it reads through coupling; balance and feasibility; how large an act's consequences beyond the closure are; which acts are taken, or that any is wrong.
- The general form of favouring what reaches beyond (when a part raising what couples in must reach beyond the closure), and the rising share of what reaches beyond with transmission, descent and openness, remain open.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The chapter's open programme (section 8.2, Selection, causes and experiment) named "The gap for one's own act as a general theorem". Becoming.Selection had it in one world (Clearing, from an instance of the closure lemma) and in general only with the second flow and the response supplied (Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling_responsive). Here the response is derived from a law of exchange (ExchangeLaw.Through.responds, counterfactual-is-the-course), and in the course form the second flow is the law's own course. Ren, 18 October 2026: "please see what else is there to do - keep pushing the frontier till finishing" (provenance, not warrant). Reading (the AI's, adopted in one account with the scope of chapter section 7, DELEGATED-CHOICES D45): what a formation can select for or against is bounded by its coupling closure, not by its reach; responding to an act whose consequences lie beyond takes a coupling that reaches them (Clearing.selected_pooled).

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [selection-through-couplings](selection-through-couplings.md). Reuses Web.SelectsThrough and Flow.unselected_beyond_coupling_responsive; the delta derives its response premise from a law of exchange and adds the act, so the gap holds for any act.
  - Output: Selection through coupling blind beyond the closure, the rest responding through coupling supplied.
  - Input: The same blindness with the act alone differing beyond the closure.
  - Preserved conditions: Balance on the conditions coupled in; the same formations present; the same start. [Selection.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [counterfactual-is-the-course](counterfactual-is-the-course.md). Reuses ExchangeLaw, ExchangeLaw.Through, Through.responds, withAct, course, levels, Feasible, course_balances_iff, withAct_follows and withAct_nonanticipating.
  - Output: The rest following a law reading through coupling responds through coupling in any two courses; a law with a part acting generates a course, balanced where feasible.
  - Input: The response premise of the gap, derived; the two flows of the course form.
  - Preserved conditions: Nonanticipating laws; feasibility. [Counterfactual.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Counterfactual.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [testing-within-couplings](testing-within-couplings.md). There nothing beyond the closure exchanges with a condition coupled into it (Flow.beyond_coupling); so a difference beyond cannot come back into the closure through a formation outside it.

**Used by:** [reading-anothers-couplings-is-pooling](reading-anothers-couplings-is-pooling.md) · [what-pooled-coupling-reaches](what-pooled-coupling-reaches.md)
